The term '''Zombie''' in [[Sinkholes]] is used as a collective term describing two types of zombies using 2 different attack styles. It consists of a warrior and ranger. They have high constitution while having a rather poor defence.

==Overview==
===Ranger===
Possibly the most commonly seen variant, they wield two hatchets and they attack by throwing axes at players. They're rather inaccurate but powerful. They are weak to melee.

===Warrior===
Similar to the ranger variants they have high constitution but very poor defence, and their attacks are somewhat accurate. They can be seen using hatchets, and are weak to magic.
